# Effortless Looping Plan — Causal Autoimmune Architecture Platform  *(derived)*

> **Demonstration of inference structure, not validated clinical decision support.**
>
> **This file is generated.** Source of truth = the `EffortlessLoops` rows in
> `effortless-rulebook/effortless-rulebook.json`. Change a loop's `Status` there (and its
> `StatusBadge`/`StatusLine`) and rerun `effortless build`. Only **current** work renders here:
> completed (`[DONE]`) loops are pruned at publish time — they live in the git history and the code.
> What shows is the current `[NEXT]` loop and the `[PLANNED]` loops that are **load-bearing for the
> v1-audit response**, then `[ROADMAP]` — the next conversation's work, deliberately *not* part of
> the audit response.

## The keystone (never lose sight of this)

Everything load-bearing chains up to one derived boolean:
**`IndividualPredictions.IsClinicallyActionable`** — TRUE only when a prediction is causally grounded,
well calibrated, not spurious, and ancestry-generalizable. It is **computed**, never entered.

## The loop (run exactly this every session)

1. **Look** at the current app/model/goal. 2. **Change the rulebook** (one coherent rule-change).
3. **`effortless build`**. 4. **Commit** (message = the rule that changed). 5. **Update the app** to
surface the new rule. 6. **Update the rulebook** `EffortlessLoops` rows (tick done, add follow-ups).
7. **Anti-hallucination sweep.** 8. **Commit again** (state summary). 9. **New agent**, back to step 1.

> Verification oracle every loop: `bootstrap/mock-data/scenarios.md` — {A,G} -> TRUE; {B,C,D,E,F} -> FALSE,
> each on its own gate, or the oracle is deliberately and visibly updated as part of the rule-change.

> Reasoning artifacts (also in the rulebook): `Axioms`, `TestsForSuccess`, `Features`, `OpenQuestions`,
> `NonGoals`, `GlossaryTerms`. Reason over those before digging into a loop.

## Loops (current work only — `[NEXT]`, `[PLANNED]`, then `[ROADMAP]`; `[DONE]` loops are pruned at publish)
>
> **`[NEXT]` + `[PLANNED]` = the v1-audit response** (load-bearing only). **`[ROADMAP]` = the next
> conversation** — present so nothing is hidden, but explicitly out of scope for the audit reply.
### [ROADMAP] Loop 13 — LLM intake clerk + synthetic lab

FUTURE ROADMAP (not part of the v1-audit response - this is the framework-thesis deliverable, the next conversation). The trust-boundary payoff: wire the LLM to read a natural-language case and write ONLY leaf observations - intake facts + synthetic-but-transparent test results - with the three-panel witness (case text / extracted facts with per-fact provenance / derived diagnosis + gate trace). The LLM never computes a higher-order inference; every value it emits is an editable knob. Demotes the model to a replaceable, fully-overridable transcriber - the structural defeat of 'a hallucination laundered through a deterministic function.'

- **Status:** roadmap
### [ROADMAP] Loop 14 — Cohort-level equity report

FUTURE ROADMAP (traceable to the original challenge's equity requirement, but not part of the v1-audit response). Ancestry-equity made structural and corpus-level: calibration and actionability rates by ancestry (gates 2 and 4 of the keystone) as a derived dashboard, complementing the cohort discovery board. Equity is a checkable rate, not a promise.

- **Status:** roadmap

> Promotion rule: a `[PLANNED]` item must be **load-bearing toward the v1-audit response** (the
